# Philippa Gordon

## Overview

- **Age:** Eighteen years old upon entering Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c4 P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c4 P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke  <sub>[v3 c4 P42](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0042)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Phil  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c6 P8](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0008), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Philippa is considered the class beauty with dark hair and a crooked mouth that breaks into a bewitching smile showing very white teeth. She takes great interest in her looks and wears stylish clothing, including a striped cap and sweater for football matches.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c4 P39](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0039), [v3 c6 P6](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0006), [v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013)_

## Personality

Philippa is a lively, charming, and carefree young woman who frequently admits to her own indecisiveness and frivolity. Despite her amusingly dramatic nature, she possesses plenty of intelligence and a loyal, affectionate soul free of snobbishness. She loves social gatherings, attention from admirers, and football matches, while remaining deeply devoted to her friends.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046), [v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 c6 P6](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0006)_

## Goals

- To enjoy college life and social fun before settling down  <sub>[v3 c4 P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048)</sub>
- To earn a B.A. degree to please her father  <sub>[v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046)</sub>

## History

Philippa Gordon grew up in Bolingbroke as the daughter of a prominent, wealthy family. At her father's insistence, she enrolled at Redmond College in Kingsport, moving into a boardinghouse on Wallace Street. Shortly after arriving, she met Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant, instantly bonding with them and introducing them into her exclusive social circle. After experiencing dissatisfaction with her initial lodging, she moved into Patty's Place on Spofford Avenue with Anne, Priscilla, and Stella. Throughout her early college years, she enjoyed a wide array of suitors while remaining a steadfast friend to her housemates.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c4 P42](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0042), [v3 c4 P43](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0043), [v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000)_
